url.description: the canonical address of the page; the entity id is derived from it, so recording the same page twice lands on one entity

frozen_at.description: when a copy of the document was stored, if one was

bytes.description: where the stored copy is: its SHA-256 address in the server's blob store

web.description: a web page as it was seen: the address that was read, and when and where a copy of it was stored
